title: Compagnies d'Ordonnance
desc: Turn the routiers who plague the countryside into a paid royal army. Field 28 regiments and France will never again depend on unreliable vassals.

title: Reclaim Normandy
desc: The English still hold Rouen and the Norman coast, and the people there are tired of foreign garrisons. Take Normandy back for the crown.

title: Drive the English Out
desc: Bordeaux and Calais are the last English footholds in your kingdom. Take Normandy, Gascony and Calais and end a war that has lasted a hundred years.

title: Bring Brittany to Heel
desc: The dukes of Brittany play you against England and keep their own court at Nantes. Bring the duchy under the crown, by marriage or by the sword.

title: The Universal Spider
desc: A clever king wins wars before they start. Gather four allies, and the French fiefs of the Duke of Burgundy become yours to claim.

title: The Burgundian Succession
desc: Burgundy was a royal gift to a younger son, and the Picard towns were only pledged. Take both back and leave the Duke only his lands in the Empire.

title: The Looms of Flanders
desc: Ghent and Bruges are among the richest cities in Christendom, and their counts owe you homage. Make Flanders French in fact as well as in law.

title: The Angevin Inheritance
desc: Good King René holds Provence as your vassal, and his line is failing. Bring Provence fully under the crown, and the Angevin claim to Naples comes with it.

title: The Road to Naples
desc: Italy is rich, divided and full of old French claims. March your gendarmes down the peninsula and take the Kingdom of Naples.

title: The Sun King
desc: With the realm whole and its borders safe, make your court the model for every crown in Europe. Reach 100 prosperity and 70 renown.

title: Hold the French Lands
desc: The truce with France will not last. Still hold Normandy, Gascony and Calais in 1455, and the French will learn that your claims are more than words.

title: The Anglo-Burgundian Alliance
desc: Your wool feeds the looms of Flanders, and the Duke of Burgundy has his own quarrel with France. Ally Burgundy and the Valois must fight on two fronts.

title: Recover Anjou and Poitou
desc: Your ancestors held all of western France. Anjou and Poitou lie between your Norman and Gascon lands: join them together.

title: Crowned in Paris
desc: A boy king of England was once crowned King of France in Notre-Dame. Take Paris and Orléans and make the double monarchy real.

title: Lordship of Ireland
desc: Your writ barely runs beyond the walls of Dublin. Bring the Gaelic lords of Ireland under the crown.

title: Hammer of the Scots
desc: The Scots raid your north and side with France in every war. End the Auld Alliance for good: take the Lowlands and the Highlands, or make Scotland your junior partner.

title: The Navy Royal
desc: An island kingdom lives by its ships. Build a navy of 18 ships to guard the Channel and carry your armies to France.

title: Rule the Waves
desc: Command three fleets and 40 ships, and no shore in Europe will be safe from English sails.

title: London, Mart of the World
desc: Merchants from every nation crowd the wharves of the Thames. Raise London to prosperity 10 and your realm to 67 prosperity.

title: The Fall of Granada
desc: Granada is the last Muslim kingdom in Iberia, guarded by mountain fortresses. Take it and finish the work of seven centuries.

title: Across the Strait
desc: Corsairs from the Barbary coast raid your shores every summer. Carry the war to Africa and take Tlemcen and the port of Oran.

title: Clear the Barbary Coast
desc: Tunis and Tripoli shelter the corsair fleets. Take both and the western sea is safe for Christian ships.

title: The Catholic Monarchs
desc: A marriage between Castile and Aragon would end a century of rivalry. Make Aragon your ally, your junior partner or your conquest.

title: Unite the Crowns
desc: An alliance is not a kingdom. Rule Aragon, Catalonia and Valencia, or hold Aragon as your junior partner, and Spain is born.

title: Unite Iberia
desc: Portugal, Navarre and Granada still stand apart. Rule every land from the Pyrenees to the Pillars of Hercules, with Aragon owned or bound to you.

title: The Great Captain
desc: Field 20 regiments and give them a commander worth following. A veteran army makes Aragon's old claims in southern Italy your business too.

title: The Kingdom of Naples
desc: French and Aragonese princes both want Naples. Take Naples, Apulia and Calabria first and make your infantry famous across Italy.

title: The Armada
desc: A kingdom on two seas needs a fleet on both. Build 30 ships and let no rival close your ports.

title: The Crown of Naples
desc: King Alfonso won Naples with his own sword, but his heirs may lose it. Hold Naples directly, or keep its king as your subject.

title: Humble Genoa
desc: Genoa has fought you for Sardinia and Corsica for a hundred years. Take the city, and its bankers will lend to you instead.

title: The Visconti Will
desc: The last Visconti duke of Milan has no son and favours your king as his heir. Make his wish good: take Lombardy and become the master of northern Italy.

title: The Catalan Fleet
desc: Barcelona's shipyards built the greatest navy of the western sea. Build 18 ships and the corsairs of Tunis will feel it.

title: Strike at Tunis
desc: The sultans of Tunis harbour the corsairs who raid your coasts. Take Tunis and its trade is yours.

title: Lord of the Western Sea
desc: Sardinia, Sicily and Tunis are the stepping stones of the western Mediterranean. Hold them all with 35 ships at sea.

title: The Navarrese Crown
desc: Your king's brother sits on the throne of Navarre, and the small kingdom guards the Pyrenees. Bring it under Aragon.

title: The Occitan Legacy
desc: Your kings once held lordships deep in Languedoc, before France drove them back over the mountains. Take Languedoc back.

title: Marry Castile
desc: Castile is your rival, but a royal marriage could make two crowns one. Ally Castile, hold it as your junior partner, or take its capital.

title: Crusade in Morocco
desc: Ceuta was only the beginning. Cross the strait and take Fez, the heart of the Moroccan sultanate.

title: The Road to Marrakesh
desc: With Fez taken, the south of Morocco lies open. Take Marrakesh and its caravan trade.

title: The Algarve Beyond the Sea
desc: Your kings already rule the Algarve. Rule Fez, Marrakesh and Tlemcen too, and they can call themselves lords of the Algarve beyond the sea.

title: The School of Sagres
desc: Your prince gathers pilots, mapmakers and shipwrights at Sagres. Build 12 ships and send them out to learn the oceans.

title: Lisbon, Queen of the Sea
desc: Spices, sugar and gold should pass through Lisbon on their way to Europe. Raise Lisbon to prosperity 8.

title: A Golden Age
desc: A small kingdom can still be the richest in Europe. Save 600 gold in your treasury and let the world envy your wealth.

title: Friends Across the Sea
desc: England is an old friend, but one ally is not enough against Castile. Gather three allies and you can look east with confidence.

title: Claim Galicia
desc: Galicians speak a tongue close to your own, and many once looked to Lisbon. Take Galicia from Castile.

title: The Iberian Crown
desc: Why should Castile lead Iberia? Rule Castile, Toledo, Galicia and Extremadura, or hold Castile as your junior partner.

title: The Lorraine Corridor
desc: Your lands are split in two: the Low Countries in the north, Burgundy in the south. Take Lorraine and join them.

title: The Fairs of Champagne
desc: Champagne is the other road between your northern and southern lands. Take it from France and its old fair towns will pay you.

title: Crown a King of Burgundy
desc: Rule every land from Holland to the Jura, add Lorraine and Champagne, and reach 50 renown. Then no emperor can refuse you a royal crown.

title: Companies of Ordinance
desc: Raise a standing army paid from your Flemish taxes. Field 25 regiments, and the indebted lords of the Upper Rhine will pledge you their lands.

title: The Upper Rhine
desc: The Upper Rhine lands have been pledged to you for gold. Take Swabia and push your border to the Rhine and the Black Forest.

title: Break the Swiss
desc: The Swiss cantons cut your road to Italy and mock your knights. Take Switzerland, and their pikemen will march for you.

title: Order of the Golden Fleece
desc: Your knightly order is the most famous in Christendom. Reach 45 renown and princes will beg to wear its collar.

title: The Habsburg Match
desc: The Emperor's family would welcome a Burgundian marriage. Ally the Habsburgs and the Empire will look kindly on your Rhine ambitions.

title: The Lower Rhine
desc: Cologne and Trier sit between Brabant and Luxembourg, rich in tolls and churches. Take them and the Rhine becomes a Burgundian river.

title: The Richest Court
desc: Painters, musicians and chroniclers flock to your court. Reach 70 prosperity and show Europe what Burgundian wealth can do.

title: The Crown of St Wenceslas
desc: Young Ladislaus is a Habsburg, and Bohemia is his by right. Rule Bohemia yourself, or hold it as your junior partner.

title: The Crown of St Stephen
desc: Hungary's nobles need a strong king against the Turks. Win their crown: rule Hungary, or hold it as your junior partner.

title: The Danubian Monarchy
desc: Unions come and go; provinces stay. Rule Bohemia, Moravia, Silesia, Hungary, Upper Hungary and Croatia directly.

title: Keep the Imperial Crown
desc: The electors chose you, but they can choose again. Stay Emperor and raise your renown to 40 to keep the princes in awe.

title: The Burgundian Match
desc: The Dukes of Burgundy are rich, and their heirs are few. Ally Burgundy, or win its crown, and one day the Low Countries may follow.

title: The Burgundian Netherlands
desc: Flanders and Brabant are the richest lands north of the Alps. Rule them directly, or hold Burgundy as your junior partner.

title: Imperial Reform
desc: The Empire needs courts, taxes and a common army. Rule as Emperor with three allies and order +2, and the Diet will listen.

title: An Imperial Army
desc: Marriages win crowns, but soldiers keep them. Field 14 regiments under a proper captain.

title: Recover the Habsburg Cradle
desc: Your family's ancestral castle stands in the Swiss lands, now held by rebellious peasants. Take Switzerland back.

title: The Military Frontier
desc: The Turks will come up the Danube sooner or later. Push the frontier south and take Serbia and Bosnia.

title: A Voice Among Electors
desc: As King of Bohemia you are the first lay elector of the Empire. Gather two allies and 35 renown, and the other electors will listen.

title: The Imperial Crown
desc: A century ago Emperor Charles IV ruled the Empire from Prague. Win the next election and bring the imperial court home.

title: Golden Prague
desc: Make Prague the greatest city of the Empire, with a university, bridges and a hundred spires. Raise it to prosperity 10 while you wear the crown.

title: The Wagon Forts
desc: Your peasant armies once beat five crusades with war wagons and handguns. Field 15 regiments and the Saxons will remember why they fear you.

title: Lusatia and Meissen
desc: Lusatia already answers to Prague, and the Saxon lands beyond it are rich in silver. Take Saxony and its mines.

title: The Luxembourg Mark
desc: Bohemian kings held Brandenburg within living memory. Take the Mark and the Altmark and hold two electoral votes.

title: The Jagiellon Friendship
desc: Poland's royal house has many sons and an eye on your throne. Make it an ally instead of a rival.

title: The Crown of Hungary
desc: Hungary's crown has passed to Bohemian kings before. Rule Hungary and Upper Hungary, or hold Hungary as your junior partner.

title: Ottokar's Legacy
desc: Long ago King Ottokar ruled from Prague to the Adriatic, until the Habsburgs took Austria from him. Take Austria, Styria and Carniola back.

title: The Bosnian Crown
desc: Bosnia's king is caught between you and the Sultan. Take Bosnia before the Turks do.

title: The Despotate of Serbia
desc: Serbia pays tribute to the Sultan, but its people still hope for a Christian lord. Free Serbia and make it Hungarian.

title: Avenge Varna
desc: Your young king died at Varna fighting the Turks. Take Bulgaria, Macedonia and Rumelia and drive the Sultan out of Europe.

title: Bulwark of Christendom
desc: Win five battles and earn 50 of the Pope's favour, and all Christendom will call you its shield against the Turk.

title: The Black Army
desc: Hire professional soldiers and pay them well. Field 18 regiments and you can afford a captain like Pál Kinizsi.

title: Moravia and Silesia
desc: Bohemia's outer lands are rich and poorly defended. Take Moravia and Silesia, and the Bohemian crown may follow.

title: The King in Vienna
desc: Vienna is the gateway between Hungary and the Empire. Take Austria and rule from its palaces.

title: Master of Wallachia
desc: Wallachia's princes switch sides with every campaign. Make Wallachia your subject or take it outright.

title: The Carpathian Passes
desc: Moldavia holds the passes into Transylvania and the road to the Black Sea. Take it and close the door to raiders.

title: Danzig, Gateway to the Sea
desc: The grain of Poland floats down the Vistula to Danzig, and the Teutonic Order takes its cut. Take the city and keep the profits.

title: Break the Teutonic Order
desc: The Knights have threatened Poland for two centuries. Take Prussia, or force the Grand Master to kneel as your vassal.

title: The Livonian Question
desc: The Livonian Order is weak and its neighbours are circling. Take Livonia before Muscovy or Sweden does.

title: A Polish Fleet
desc: Danzig's shipwrights are as good as any. Build a fleet of 10 ships to guard the mouth of the Vistula.

title: Winged Hussars
desc: Your nobles are born in the saddle. Field 16 regiments and train the finest heavy horse in Europe.

title: The Silesian Piasts
desc: Silesia's dukes are Piasts, kin of Poland's old kings, but they answer to Prague. Bring Silesia home.

title: From Sea to Sea
desc: Make Poland the bridge between two seas: hold Danzig on the Baltic and a Black Sea coast in Moldavia, Ochakov, Zaporozhia or Crimea.

title: The Jagiellonian League
desc: Your dynasty rules or courts half of Central Europe. Gather three allies and make the Jagiellons the first house of the east.

title: The Union of Lublin
desc: Poland and Lithuania are bound by blood and treaty, but not yet one state. Hold Lithuania as your junior partner, or stay its ally with 60 renown and order +2.

title: Humble Moscow
desc: The princes of Moscow call themselves lords of all Rus, but Lithuania is the greater power. Take Moscow and end their pretensions.

title: Lord of All Rus
desc: The heartland of the old Russian principalities is within reach. Take Vladimir, Yaroslavl and Tver.

title: Protector of Novgorod
desc: Novgorod's merchants would rather have a distant Lithuanian lord than a Muscovite one. Take Novgorod and Pskov and their fur trade.

title: To the Black Sea
desc: Grand Duke Vytautas held the coast from the Dniester to the Dnieper, built a fort at Dashiv and watered his horse in the Black Sea. Take Ochakov and the coast will be yours again.

title: The Crimean Khanate
desc: The Khans of Crimea raid your lands for captives every summer. Take the peninsula and its rich ports.

title: Break the Great Horde
desc: The Great Horde still rides the Don steppe. Drive it from the Don and its khan will be left with the camps of the Volga.

title: The Grand Ducal Host
desc: Your realm is vast but its army is small. Field 18 regiments and find a captain worthy of them.

title: A Port on the Baltic
desc: The Livonian Order holds the coast north of your lands. Take Livonia and give Lithuania a proper port.

title: The Greatest Realm in Europe
desc: From the Baltic to the steppe, no realm in Europe is larger. Rule 16 regions with 60 renown.

title: Absorb Ryazan
desc: Ryazan is a Russian principality too small to stand alone. Bring it under Moscow before the Tatars or Lithuanians do.

title: The Fall of Novgorod
desc: Lord Novgorod the Great is rich, proud and flirting with Lithuania. Take the city and silence its assembly bell.

title: Gather the Russian Lands
desc: Tver, Ryazan, Novgorod and Pskov are Russian lands, and they belong under one prince. Rule them all from Moscow.

title: A Window to the West
desc: Russia needs a Baltic port to trade with the West. Take Estonia, Livonia or a Finnish port.

title: Stand on the Ugra
desc: The Horde still demands tribute from Moscow. Field 14 regiments, win a war, and send the khan's envoys home empty-handed.

title: End the Great Horde
desc: The Horde that once burned Moscow is a shadow of itself. Take its pastures on the Don.

title: The Wild Fields
desc: The Crimean Khan's raiders strike deep into your lands. Take Crimea and Zaporozhia and close the steppe road for good.

title: The Third Rome
desc: If Constantinople falls, Moscow will carry the Orthodox faith; while it stands, it needs a friend. Reach 40 renown with Byzantium gone or your ally.

title: The Smolensk Gate
desc: Smolensk guards the road from Moscow to the west, and Lithuania holds it. Take the fortress.

title: Tsar of All Russia
desc: Crown yourself Tsar. Rule 15 regions with 60 renown and the world will have to accept the title.

title: Take Constantinople
desc: The Queen of Cities stands between your European and Asian lands, guarded by the greatest walls in the world. Break them.

title: Greece and Albania
desc: The Despots of the Morea and Skanderbeg's rebels in Albania defy you. Take both and secure your western flank.

title: Serbia and Bosnia
desc: Your Serbian vassal and the Bosnian king are weak and divided. Make their lands Ottoman provinces.

title: The Hungarian Plain
desc: Hungary is the shield of Christendom. Shatter it and the road to the heart of Europe lies open.

title: The Golden Apple
desc: Vienna, the golden apple, is the gateway to the German lands. Take Austria and the Christian princes will tremble.

title: The Janissary Corps
desc: The sultan's household infantry is the finest in the world. Field 22 regiments and the Turkmen beys of Anatolia will bow.

title: Unite Anatolia
desc: Karaman and Trebizond are the last independent powers in Anatolia. Take them and rule all the lands of the Turks.

title: The Imperial Arsenal
desc: Gallipoli's shipyards can build a fleet to rival Venice. Launch 22 ships, and the knights on Rhodes will be next.

title: The Siege of Rhodes
desc: The Knights of St John raid your shipping from their fortress island. Take Rhodes and end their raids.

title: An Ottoman Sea
desc: Cyprus and Crete are the last Christian strongholds in the eastern sea. Take them and the Levant trade is yours.

title: The Lombard Wars
desc: Milan's dukes are your oldest enemies on the mainland. Take Lombardy and make your mainland state safe for good.

title: Ravenna and the Romagna
desc: Ravenna's salt pans and the Romagna's towns guard your southern border. Take them, even if the Pope objects.

title: Crush Genoa
desc: Genoa is your great rival at sea, and Lombardy opens the road to it by land. Take the city and its trading posts are yours.

title: The Arsenal
desc: Your Arsenal can build a galley a day when it must. Launch 22 ships and claim the far shore of the Adriatic.

title: Rule the Adriatic
desc: The Adriatic is the Gulf of Venice. Hold both shores: Dalmatia, Albania and Apulia.

title: The Stato da Mar
desc: Your empire of islands and ports guards the road to the East. Hold the Morea, Candia and Cyprus.

title: League Against the Turk
desc: The Sultan's fleet grows every year. Ally Hungary, the strongest Christian army in the east, and he will have to fight on land as well as at sea.

title: The Riches of the Rialto
desc: Bankers, brokers and spice merchants crowd the Rialto. Fill the treasury with 500 gold.

title: Queen of the Adriatic
desc: Make Venice the most splendid city in Europe, with marble palaces on every canal. Raise it to prosperity 10.

title: Tame the Great Lords
desc: The Black Douglases and the Lord of the Isles answer to no one. Bring your realm to order +2 and grow Edinburgh to prosperity 5.

title: Build the Great Michael
desc: A proper navy would carry your soldiers to France and Ireland. Build 8 ships, led by the largest warship in the north.

title: Over the Border
desc: Berwick and Roxburgh have changed hands before. Take Northumbria from the English while they are busy in France.

title: The Bruce Claim to Ireland
desc: A Bruce was once crowned High King of Ireland. Cross the North Channel and take Ulster, where Edward Bruce's army landed.

title: The Heart of England
desc: With the north secure, strike at the Midlands and cut England in two.

title: A Scottish King in London
desc: Take London, or make England your junior partner, and a Scottish king will rule the whole island.

title: The Scottish Renaissance
desc: Universities, poets at court and a royal printing press. Reach 16 prosperity and 40 renown.

title: Schleswig and Holstein
desc: The counts of Holstein have no heirs, and Lübeck's merchants grow fat on your Baltic trade. Take Holstein.

title: Guard the Sound
desc: Every ship entering the Baltic pays your toll at Helsingør. Build 12 ships to make sure they do.

title: The Kalmar Union Endures
desc: Swedish nobles chafe under your rule. Keep Sweden as your junior partner, or rule it outright, until 1470.

title: The Duchy of Estonia
desc: Your ancestors held Reval and the Estonian coast. Take Estonia back from the Order.

title: Break the Hansa
desc: The Hanseatic towns of Lübeck and Lüneburg think they own the Baltic trade. Take Holstein and Brunswick and teach them otherwise.

title: Three Crowns, One King
desc: A union can be broken; a kingdom cannot. Rule Svealand, Götaland and Finland directly.

title: Masters of the North
desc: Make Denmark the great power of the north, with 38 prosperity and 20 regiments under arms.

title: Break the Kalmar Union
desc: Danish bailiffs tax your miners and your nobles. Rise up and win Sweden its freedom.

title: The Great Copper Mountain
desc: The mines of Falun produce most of Europe's copper. Bring your lands to 17 prosperity and the profits will fill your treasury.

title: Take Scania
desc: Scania belongs on your side of the Sound. Take it from Denmark and share the toll.

title: The Karelian Frontier
desc: Novgorod's forests run to the walls of Vyborg, and the border has never been settled. Take Karelia.

title: Across the Gulf
desc: Reval and Narva carry the trade of half of Russia. Cross the gulf and take Estonia.

title: Make the Baltic Swedish
desc: Hold Scania and Livonia, a foothold on the southern shore, and 20 ships. The Baltic becomes a Swedish lake.

title: The Lion of the North
desc: Field 20 regiments and win ten battles, and Europe will learn to fear the Swedish infantry.

title: The Pomeranian Claim
desc: The Dukes of Pomerania owe you homage by treaty, if not in practice. Take Pomerania and reach the sea.

title: Drill and Discipline
desc: A poor land needs a good army. Field 12 regiments and drill them until they march like clockwork.

title: Build Up Berlin
desc: Berlin is a muddy town on the Spree. Raise it to prosperity 6 and give your court a proper capital.

title: The Duchy of Prussia
desc: The Teutonic Order is weakening, and Prussia's estates want a secular lord. Take Prussia, or bind the Order to you as your junior partner.

title: A Kingdom in Prussia
desc: Join your scattered lands: hold Brandenburg, Pomerania, Danzig and Prussia with 50 renown, and crown yourself king.

title: Seize Silesia
desc: Silesia is rich, close and badly defended. With a drilled army it can be yours in a single campaign.

title: A Hohenzollern Emperor
desc: You already have an elector's vote. Win the imperial election and make the Empire bow to Berlin.

title: Hire Francesco Sforza
desc: The finest condottiero in Italy is married to your duke's daughter. Pay for 12 regiments and he will lead them.

title: Lordship over Genoa
desc: Genoa has been Milanese before, and its harbour would make you rich. Take Liguria and its bankers.

title: The Court of Milan
desc: The best painters and engineers in Italy could work for you. Raise Milan to prosperity 10 and your renown to 40.

title: Crush Venice
desc: The Venetians have eaten into your eastern lands for decades. Take the Veneto and push them back into their lagoon.

title: The Iron Crown of Lombardy
desc: Rule Lombardy with Parma, Liguria, the Venetian mainland and the Romagna, and take up the ancient crown of the Lombard kings.

title: The Tuscan Banks
desc: Florence's bankers fund every war in Italy. Take Tuscany and they will fund yours.

title: King of Italy
desc: Italy has not been one realm since the fall of Rome. Rule from the Alps to the heel, adding Rome, Naples and Apulia to your northern kingdom.

title: Reunite the Two Sicilies
desc: Sicily and Naples were one kingdom until a revolt split them. Take Sicily and join them again.

title: The Fertile South
desc: Your plains could feed half of Italy if they were properly worked. Bring your lands to 24 prosperity.

title: The Galleys of Naples
desc: Turkish and Barbary corsairs raid your coasts. Build 12 ships and carry the fight to them.

title: Skanderbeg's Friends
desc: Albania's warlords look to Naples for help against the Sultan. Take Albania and hold the gate of the Adriatic.

title: The Tunisian Shore
desc: Tunis lies a short sail from Sicily and shelters the corsairs. Take it.

title: Master of Rome
desc: A King of Naples has held Rome before. With your lands prosperous, march north and take the Eternal City.

title: A Kingdom of Italy
desc: Rule Naples, Apulia, Sicily, Rome, the Romagna and Tuscany: the heart of the peninsula south of the Po.

title: Hold the Ordensland
desc: Your towns plot with Poland and your knights grow old. Still hold Danzig, Marienburg and Prussia in 1466 and the Order will survive.

title: Strengthen Marienburg
desc: Marienburg is the heart of the Order. Hold it, field 12 regiments of a new generation of knights, and make it the strongest fortress in the north.

title: Reunite with Livonia
desc: The Livonian Order is your sister branch. Bring it under your direct rule, or make it your subject.

title: Strike at Masovia
desc: Masovia lies between Prussia and the Polish heartland. Take it and Poland will have to fight on your terms.

title: Win Back Samogitia
desc: Samogitia once joined Prussia to Livonia, until Lithuania tore it away. Take Lithuania's western lands.

title: Crusade Against Pskov
desc: The Orthodox merchants of Pskov stand between you and the rich lands of the east. Take Pskov.

title: The Monastic State
desc: Rule Danzig, Marienburg, Prussia, Masovia and Lithuania, nine regions in all, and the Order will be a great power for centuries.

title: Weather the Storm
desc: The Sultan gathers guns and men to take your city. Still hold Constantinople in 1460 and the world will know Rome is not finished.

title: Friends in the West
desc: The Latins demand church union in return for help. Ally Hungary or Venice and let them share the burden of the war.

title: Raise a New Guard
desc: Your army is a few thousand men behind old walls. Field 12 regiments and hire a captain worthy of them.

title: Retake Thrace
desc: Rumelia is the Sultan's European heartland and lies at your gates. Take it and the city can breathe again.

title: Restore Hellas
desc: Thessaly and Macedonia link your Morea to the capital. Take them back from the Turks.

title: Return to Asia
desc: Across the Bosphorus lies Bithynia, where the Ottomans first grew strong. Take it and carry the war into Asia.

title: Reunite with Trebizond
desc: Another Roman emperor rules at Trebizond, far across the Black Sea. Bring his realm back under Constantinople.

title: Restore the Empire
desc: Rule the Morea, Thrace, Bulgaria, Macedonia, Thessaly, Bithynia and Aydın, and the Empire of the Romans lives again.

title: Muster the Levies
desc: A realm that cannot defend itself will not last. Raise 7 regiments and find a captain to lead them.

title: A First Victory
desc: Nothing wins respect like a war won. Defeat an enemy and make them sign the peace.

title: New Lands
desc: Your realm is too small to be safe. Rule at least 3 regions.

title: A Regional Power
desc: Rule 6 regions with 25 prosperity, and the great powers will have to take you seriously.

title: Guard the Realm
desc: If you have a coast, build 6 ships to guard it. If you have none, raise 10 regiments to hold your borders.

title: Build Up the Capital
desc: Roads, markets and a proper cathedral. Raise your capital to prosperity 7.

title: A Stable Realm
desc: Calm the nobles and fill the granaries. Reach order +2.

title: Jewel of the Realm
desc: Make your capital a city that visitors write home about. Raise it to prosperity 9.

title: Friends Abroad
desc: A small realm survives by its friendships. Have at least two allies.

title: A Name Abroad
desc: Let your court be spoken of in every capital. Reach 50 renown.

title: The Cape Verde Islands
desc: Empty islands lie off the great cape of Africa, a perfect harbour on the road south and west. Settle Cape Verde and your ships will have a home port in the open ocean.

title: Plant the Cross in Brazil
desc: A green coast lies far to the south-west, rich in red dyewood. Found a colony anywhere on the coast of Brazil and claim it for Portugal before others do.

title: The Sugar Captaincies
desc: Pernambuco and Bahia have rich red soil and a climate made for sugar cane. Hold both and the mills of Brazil will make Lisbon the sugar market of Europe.

title: The State of Brazil
desc: Bind the scattered captaincies into one colony under a governor-general in Salvador. Own six regions in the New World.

title: The General Mines
desc: Backwoodsmen swear the hills behind Rio and São Vicente hide gold. Push inland and take Minas Gerais before anyone else learns the way.

title: The Enterprise of the Indies
desc: A Genoese pilot swore the Indies lay just across the western ocean. Whatever lies there, plant the first Castilian settlement and make it a base for everything that follows.

title: Tierra Firme
desc: The islands are only a stepping stone. Gain a foothold on the mainland, from Florida to the Main, and hear the rumours of empires inland for yourself.

title: The Conquest of Mexico
desc: The Aztec capital stands on a lake in the highlands, its temples heaped with gold. Take Anáhuac and the riches of the Mexica are yours.

title: The Fifth of the Indies
desc: The crown's fifth of every American mine pays for armies in Europe. Own a region that yields silver and another that yields gold.

title: The Viceroyalty of New Spain
desc: Rule the Indies through viceroys, courts and councils, as a kingdom in their own right. Own ten regions in the New World.

title: Plant an English Colony
desc: Spain and Portugal grow rich across the ocean while English sailors only fish the northern banks. Found an English colony anywhere in the New World.

title: Virginia
desc: The Chesapeake and the Carolina coast have deep rivers, safe anchorages and soil that grows tobacco as fine as any in the Spanish Indies. Settle either one.

title: New England
desc: Stony fields, rich fisheries and dissenters who want to worship far from your bishops. Settle New England and let them build their city on a hill.

title: The West Indies
desc: One small island planted with sugar can be worth more than a county at home. Take Jamaica, the Lesser Antilles or any of the great Caribbean islands.

title: The American Plantations
desc: From the northern fisheries to the southern tobacco fields, let the coast of America speak English. Own eight regions in the New World.

title: Adam's Will
desc: Show me the clause in Adam's will that leaves the world to Spain and Portugal, a French king once asked. Found a French colony anywhere in the New World.

title: The Habitation at Quebec
desc: Where the great river narrows beneath a cliff, a fort commands the way into the heart of the continent. Found a French colony at Quebec.

title: The Huron Country
desc: Beyond the rapids live the Huron, great traders and enemies of the Haudenosaunee. Settle among them and the fur trade of the lakes is yours.

title: Louisiana
desc: Your explorers have followed the great river of the west all the way to the Gulf. Plant a colony at its mouth and name the land for your king.

title: Saint-Domingue
desc: The sugar of Hispaniola could make it the richest island in the world. Plant the French flag on Hispaniola or in the Lesser Antilles.

title: New Netherland
desc: The Hudson runs deep into fur country, and its mouth is one of the finest harbours on the coast. Plant a Burgundian colony in the Hudson Valley.

title: The Wild Coast
desc: Between the Orinoco and the Amazon lies a coast of rivers and swamps where sugar grows well and no crown rules. Settle Guiana, the Orinoco or the islands off them.

title: Sugar from Pernambuco
desc: The mills of Pernambuco make more sugar than any land on earth, and its masters can barely defend it. Take it, by settlement or by war.

title: Masters of the Atlantic Trade
desc: Your ships carry the sugar, furs and tobacco of half the world. Own six regions in the New World and a fleet of 30 ships.

title: Rediscover Greenland
desc: No ship has reached the old Norse farms of Greenland in living memory. With Iceland as your stepping stone, charter a company to sail west and settle the lands beyond.

title: The Danish West Indies
desc: A small Caribbean island can be a free port for every nation, with Danish customs men taking their share. Plant a colony in Puerto Rico or the Lesser Antilles.

title: Vinland Regained
desc: The sagas tell of Vinland, where Leif Eriksson found wild grapes beyond Greenland. Plant a Danish colony on the northern coasts where the Norse once landed.

title: A Charter for Nova Scotia
desc: Other crowns are carving out colonies across the ocean, and Scotland must not be left behind. Sell baronetcies to pay for settlers and charter a New Scotland in America.

title: New Scotland
desc: The northern coasts are as wild and wet as the Highlands. Plant a Scottish colony in Acadia or Newfoundland and name it for home.

title: New Caledonia
desc: Whoever holds the isthmus of Darien holds the key to two oceans. Plant a Scottish colony in Panama and make Edinburgh rich on the trade of the world.

title: The Western Sea
desc: A New World has been found across the ocean. Build a fleet fit to cross it: at least eight ships.

title: A Colony Overseas
desc: Plant your flag on the far side of the ocean. Own a region in the New World.

title: Riches of the Indies
desc: Turn a foothold into a colonial empire. Own three regions in the New World.

title: Guardians of the Holy Cities
desc: Mecca and Medina look to Cairo for grain, gold and protection. Hold the Hejaz with a settled realm and every Muslim prince will honour your name.

title: The Tribute of Cyprus
desc: Your fathers burned Limassol and carried the King of Cyprus to Cairo in chains. Make the island pay again, as your vassal or as your own.

title: The Siege of Rhodes
desc: The Knights of St John raid your coasts from their island fortress. Take Rhodes and the eastern sea is yours.

title: The Spice Road
desc: Pepper and cloves come up the Red Sea to Cairo and leave Alexandria in Venetian ships. Make Cairo the richest city on the road.

title: A Fleet for the Red Sea
desc: Frankish ships have rounded Africa and mean to steal the spice trade. Build a fleet strong enough to drive them from the Indian Ocean.

title: The Royal Mamluks
desc: The Sultan's own slave soldiers are the finest horsemen in Islam, but they are few and quarrelsome. Raise an army worthy of Baybars.

title: The Northern Frontier
desc: Turkmen princes in the Taurus and on the upper Tigris play you against the Ottomans. Bring Karaman or Diyarbakir under your banner.

title: A Bride from Trebizond
desc: The Emperor of Trebizond has a daughter famed across Asia and a city that needs a strong friend. An alliance would bind the Komnenoi to your house.

title: Break the Black Sheep
desc: Jahan Shah of the Black Sheep rules from Tabriz and calls you his vassal. Take his capital and every Turkmen tribe will follow the White Sheep.

title: Lords of the Two Rivers
desc: Mosul and Baghdad command the Tigris and the roads to the Gulf. Hold both and the old lands of the caliphs pay their taxes to you.

title: Cannon from Venice
desc: Venetian envoys promise guns and gunners against the Ottomans. Your horsemen must learn to fight beside them before the Sultan comes east.

title: Stand Firm Against the Sultan
desc: The Ottomans will suffer no rival in the east. Raise twenty regiments and keep your realm in good order, and the Sultan will think twice.

title: A Turkmen Empire
desc: From the Euphrates to the Caspian the tribes answer to one house. Rule eight regions and take the titles of the old Persian kings.

title: The Blue Mosque
desc: Your builders are covering a new mosque in Tabriz with tiles the colour of the evening sky. Make your capital worthy of it.

title: Crush the White Sheep
desc: Uzun Hasan of the White Sheep is young, clever and hungry. Take Diyarbakir before he grows strong enough to take Tabriz from you.

title: The Road into Anatolia
desc: Erzurum guards the high road west to the Ottoman lands. Hold it and every caravan between Tabriz and Bursa pays you on the way.

title: Tribute from the Georgians
desc: Your armies have burned Georgian towns before. Make the Georgian king your vassal, or take Kartli outright, and the mountains will pay.

title: A Loyal Baghdad
desc: Princes sent to govern Baghdad have a habit of declaring themselves sultans. Keep the city, and keep good order across your realm.

title: Sultan of Iran
desc: Isfahan, Shiraz and Kerman already send you tribute. Rule eight regions here and the Timurid princes in Herat will bow as well.

title: One Crown for Georgia
desc: The princes of Kakheti, Imereti and Samtskhe already act like kings. Keep the realm whole and settled before it breaks into pieces.

title: The Comnenian Alliance
desc: Trebizond is the last Greek empire on the Black Sea, and Georgian princesses sit on its throne. Turn the family tie into an alliance.

title: Guard the Mountain Passes
desc: Every invader comes through the same few passes. Raise levies enough to hold them and build walls where the roads narrow.

title: Envoys to the West
desc: Your envoys sat at the Council of Florence and still tour the courts of Europe asking for a crusade. Win friends who will answer.

title: Avenge Tbilisi
desc: The Black Sheep burned your capital and carried off its people. Take Van or Tabriz and let the Turkmen learn what fear is.

title: Ships of Colchis
desc: The ports of Imereti look out on the Black Sea. Build a fleet and Georgian merchants can carry their own silk to Caffa and Constantinople.

title: The Loyal Kings
desc: The kings of Waalo, Kayor, Baol, Sine and Saloum pay tribute to the Buurba. Keep the peace and good order and they will stay loyal.

title: Horses from the North
desc: Desert traders and Portuguese caravels bring horses worth their weight in gold. Mount your best warriors and rule the open plains.

title: The Gambia River
desc: The river kingdoms of the Gambia still look to the distant Mansa of Mali. Bring them under the Buurba and the river trade is yours.

title: A Prince in Lisbon
desc: Portuguese captains offer friendship, guns and trade. Send a prince to Lisbon, or win allies nearer home, and you will not stand alone.

title: Scholars of the Faith
desc: Teachers of the Quran travel from town to town. Give them schools and a fine capital and the faith will bind your people together.

title: Great Jolof
desc: From the Senegal to the Gambia the Wolof answer to one throne. Rule three regions and no vassal king will dare to break away.

title: Keep Timbuktu
desc: Tuareg raiders and the upstart Songhai covet the city of scholars. Hold Timbuktu until 1470 and the world will know Mali still stands.

title: The Gold of Bure
desc: The gold fields of Bure and Bambuk made Mansa Musa the richest man alive. Put miners and markets back to work around your capital.

title: The Mansa's Army
desc: Archers and armoured horsemen once marched from the ocean to the desert. Raise an army fit to remind your neighbours who rules here.

title: Envoys to the Portuguese
desc: Strange ships have reached the Gambia. Their friendship could help the Mansa against Songhai and the Fula. Send envoys and win allies.

title: A Pilgrimage to Mecca
desc: Mansa Musa's pilgrimage is still talked about in Cairo. Gather 300 gold and go again: the cost is great, the honour greater.

title: Restore the Empire
desc: Mali once ruled from the Atlantic to beyond the Niger bend. Rule five regions again and the old provinces will remember their Mansa.

title: Take Timbuktu
desc: Timbuktu's scholars and salt merchants grow fat under a weak Mansa. Take the city and its wealth will pay for the empire to come.

title: The Sunni's Horsemen
desc: Songhai's kings ride at the head of their armies and strike before an enemy can gather. Raise ten regiments and teach them speed.

title: Djenné and the Upper Niger
desc: Djenné's merchants and the gold roads of the upper Niger still answer to Mali. Take the Mansa's heartland and the river is yours.

title: The Askia's Pilgrimage
desc: A Songhai ruler with gold to spare may go to Mecca as Mansa Musa did, and come home a caliph. Gather 300 gold after 1490.

title: Empire of the Niger
desc: From Gao to the upper Niger every town and caravan pays tribute to Songhai. Rule five regions and build the greatest empire in Africa.

title: Guns Against Morocco
desc: The Sultan of Morocco covets the gold of the Niger and buys guns from Europe. Arm your own soldiers before his musketeers cross the desert.
